name: Goblin Warlord
bio: Rules the warren by fear, spite and a very large knife.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-05 ("Goblin Warlord villain", rigged and animated on Meshy (Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its own finger joints and weights kept (`fixes.fingers` default, intake step 2a: the grip audit scored them better than or level with the re-fit); its clips not used)). A green goblin in spiked leather armour and a tattered cloak hung with skulls (the owner's "fantasy": Knights & Legends). Small, as every goblin is (owner, 2026-11-05: "make every goblin character small"; it was standard at first, a warlord). Not Snikkit (Goblin Mischief replaces Snikkit). Display name a placeholder for the owner.
